title: pancashloki — pan-p02
question: O Maheśa, at Your door let this charming speech of mine flash forth exceedingly — "Victory, victory to Maheśa!" — faultless and unceasing. Let this very speech, auspicious, be bliss-giving for me forever. O Lord, O giver of refuge, make me — whose protector is Maheśa — possessed of a protector!
